category: serverless Postgres with a compute layer

free_tier.stated: 200,000 operations per month, 2 GB storage, 50 databases, 10 direct connections, and Prisma Compute with 1 million requests

per_object_cap.stated: 2 GB storage on Free; 10 connections direct and 10 pooled

retention.stated: when the free query allowance is used, the database stops accepting read and write requests until an upgrade or the allowance resets at the start of the next calendar month; data is not deleted
retention.notes: null is indefinite: a claimed Free database has no time limit; idle databases scale to zero and the next query wakes them; an instant database is deleted after 24 hours unless claimed

egress.terms: the database itself has no egress fee on any published plan; Prisma Compute includes 10 GB of outbound bandwidth a month and then USD 0.025 per GB
egress.free_allowance: no database egress fee; 10 GB per month on Prisma Compute

interface_detail: the Postgres wire protocol; the Prisma ORM; a Management API
tooling: the Prisma ORM, psql, any Postgres client
chaining: 50 databases on one free account is the widest per-tenant fan-out in this class, if 10 connections per database is enough

limits.value: 200,000 operations per month; every query is one operation
10 direct connections and 10 pooled connections on Free

identity_cost.detail: email signup; no card on Free

reliability_note: no suspension, throttle or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read
confidence_note: the pricing page's plan table was read on 2026-10-22, and the 10-connection ceiling is on it beside the operation count and the storage allowance.

evidence.proved: Free: 200k operations, 2 GB storage, 50 databases, connection limit pooled 10, connection limit direct 10, connection idle timeout 60 minutes, data transfer unlimited; Prisma Compute Free 1M requests, 360 GB-hours provisioned memory, 4 vCPU-hours active CPU, 10 GB outbound bandwidth
the FAQ states that the database stops accepting read and write requests at the free query limit, resumes on upgrade or at the monthly reset, and the data is not deleted while blocked
evidence.quote: your Prisma Postgres database stops accepting read and write requests. ... upgrade to a [paid plan](https://www.prisma.io/pricing) to restore access ... or wait until your query allowance resets at the start of the next calendar month. ... While queries are blocked, your data is not deleted.

evidence.proved: the free-tier page states a claimed database has no time limit, idle databases scale to zero and the next query wakes them, and an unclaimed instant database is deleted after 24 hours
evidence.quote: A claimed database, and a database created in the Prisma Console, has no time limit. ... Idle databases scale to zero and cost nothing on the Free plan. You never have to wake one by hand: the next query wakes it ... Instant databases are deleted in 24 hours unless claimed.

price_per_tb_month: USD 8 per million operations; storage USD 2.00/GB beyond 10 GB on Starter
notes: 200,000 operations a month is 6,667 a day, which is a prototype and not a service. The 10-connection ceiling is the second wall and it is the one that shows up when a pooler is added and the pool itself is the limit.
